provenance.random: IID sampling at corpus single-letter frequencies, lengths drawn from the corpus length distribution
provenance.shuffled: dinucleotide-preserving shuffles of the validated group

E1.title: Tier 1 discriminates validated aptamers from matched controls
E1.design: out-of-fold, folds grouped by target so no held-out sequence is scored against its own target's family

E2.title: Structural scores reflect arrangement, not composition
E2.note: pass = Monte-Carlo p <= 0.05 against 20 dinucleotide-preserving shuffles of the sequence itself
